budget.warning: Milestones are a proposal, not an authorized reduction of the 100-epoch target. GH200 approved end-to-end rates pending. Trainer has no DDP.

paper_experiments.name: Full dynamic manipulation
paper_experiments.protocol: Paired official DOM scenes/tasks; full success and termination time, 9 dimension breakdown, 1800 trials per selected checkpoint when benchmark integration is validated; report successful-only completion time separately

paper_experiments.name: Six method ablations
paper_experiments.protocol: Same frozen split, initialization, optimizer updates, effective batch, sampling, normalization, precision; frozen validation selection

paper_experiments.name: Practical motion inputs
paper_experiments.protocol: Causal visual motion estimates at inference, oracle motion as upper bound; all variants get the same motion-information budget; audit phase gate for action-label/future leakage

paper_experiments.name: Fair streaming execution
paper_experiments.protocol: Full released DynamicVLA CI+LAAS baseline and corresponding KR wrappers; same inference hardware; add fixed-execution controlled comparison; no training changes needed for wrapper-only conditions

paper_experiments.name: External models
paper_experiments.protocol: SmolVLA baseline plus KR-SmolVLA paired training first, then pi0.5 plus RTC execution; OpenVLA-OFT baseline if budget supports; baseline adapters require implementation/readiness checks

paper_experiments.name: Motion robustness
paper_experiments.protocol: Static case, speed extrapolation, acceleration, direction changes, occlusion, velocity noise/delay and inference latency; reuse checkpoints

paper_experiments.name: Learning and mechanism
paper_experiments.protocol: Success vs equal updates, target variance/covariance, conditional distribution alignment diagnostic; physical-unit target comparison; convergence vs GPU hours separately

paper_experiments.name: Repeatability
paper_experiments.protocol: Three training seeds on main baseline vs selected KR variant, paired rollout seeds and scene-group confidence intervals

paper_experiments.name: Fine-tuning data efficiency
paper_experiments.protocol: Nested 10/25/50/100 percent train episode subsets only for main pair; equal updates plus equal data-pass views; pretrained DOM overlap prevents claims of unseen pretraining data efficiency

paper_experiments.name: Real-world
paper_experiments.protocol: Pending hardware availability; paired main pair plus external baseline on a few dynamic grasp/place tasks, frozen scoring and conditions

existing_tracking_results.scope: Completed CR/DA/LS tracking adaptations in one room; time-within-3cm coverage is not DOM manipulation success; LS is continuous tracking, not sequencing

migration_rule: One active owner per experiment. Move pending work first. For running work transfer a complete training checkpoint with optimizer/scheduler/RNG/sampler cursor and verify destination resume before stopping source. Do not alter frozen run variables in place.
